prompt_set_note: All prompts in this preserved set are engineering diagnostics. They are not natural-user GEO monitoring prompts and their results must not support formal GEO behavior conclusions.

prompts.text: 请联网说明 2026 年中国新能源汽车出口的近期公开数据，并列出来源。
